_comment: Hot-sheet figures, carried from a published artifact rather than computed here.
Another session built the hot sheet -- the per-community screen a regional
opens before a call -- and published it to the live artifact at the timestamp
below WITHOUT committing the pipeline code that produced it. The component and
its stylesheet were recovered from the published page and now live in
dashboard/app.js and dashboard/styles.css; these numbers are its input,
They are NOT recomputed by build.py, and three of the fields could not be even
if the rest were: pds_poh, acquired_date and acquired_price come from Property
Data Sheet columns that pipeline/queries.json does not extract.
SO THESE GO STALE. build.py raises a flag naming the date. The fix is for
whoever wrote that pipeline step to push it, at which point this file and the
flag that reads it both get deleted.
